text: もう　すこし　よわい　ひとと　れんしゅう　して　くるよ

structure.jp: もう　すこし　よわい　ひとと
れんしゅう　して　くるよ

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.span: れんしゅう　して　くる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb here means going off to do something and then coming back. れんしゅう　して　くる = 'I'll go practice and come back'.

patterns.name: 〜と (with)
patterns.explanation: と after a person shows who you do something together with. ひとと = 'with a person'.
